what: The quoted section of results/speech_luck.json as it stood on 2026-10-15, with four outcomes (ear only, skin graze, serious wound or death, miss). Superseded on 2026-10-16 when Sam cut the skin-graze outcome; kept so nothing is lost.

final_turn.definition: Before the chart = more than 51 s before the shot; the chart minute = the last 51 s. 'Within 35 degrees' = face within 35 degrees of the rifle line either way. Ear-only chance = one head-aimed shot hitting only an ear, averaged over the frames.

face_angle_at_shot.quote: about 10 degrees short of the rifle
face_angle_at_shot.source: the camera, at its solved position, give or take 12 degrees
face_angle_at_shot.not_quoted: 8 degrees short is the combined video-and-wound estimate (90% range 5 past to 25 short). It is not a caption figure: it only centres the weighting behind the at-turn odds, which average over the uncertainty in his turn (at exactly 10 degrees a graze would be 1.64% and ear-only 0.82%).
